[invite http: 200]

observation.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
# Second user: log in as tom@example.com via the same SSO flow
REDIR="http://localhost:8008/capture"
curl -s -D m1.txt --max-time 10 "http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/login/sso/redirect/oidc?redirectUrl=$REDIR" -o /dev/null
AUTH=$(grep -i '^location' m1.txt | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^[Ll]ocation: //')
rm -f mdex.txt
curl -s -c mdex.txt --max-time 10 -L "$AUTH" -o mdexform.html
MFA=$(grep -o 'action="[^"]*"' mdexform.html | head -1 | sed 's/action="//;s/"//' | sed 's/&/\&/g')
curl -s -b mdex.txt -c mdex.txt --data-urlencode "login=tom@example.com" --data-urlencode "password=changeme" -D mdexh.txt -o /dev/null -e "http://dex:5556${MFA}" "http://dex:5556${MFA}"
M_CB=$(grep -i '^location:' mdexh.txt | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^[Ll]ocation: //')
curl -s -D mcbh.txt --max-time 20 "$M_CB" -o /dev/null
LTOKEN=$(grep -i '^location' mcbh.txt | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/.*loginToken=//')
LOGIN=$(curl -s --max-time 20 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"type\":\"m.login.token\",\"token\":\"$LTOKEN\"}" http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/login)
TOM_USER=$(echo "$LOGIN" | sed 's/.*"user_id":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
TOM_TOKEN=$(echo "$LOGIN" | sed 's/.*"access_token":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
echo "second user: $TOM_USER"
echo "$TOM_TOKEN" > tom_token.txt
echo "$TOM_USER" > tom_user.txt
echo "$TOM_USER" > tom_user.txt
echo "=== now invite tom to the room as alex ==="
ALEX_TOKEN=$(cat alex_token.txt)
ROOM_ID=$(cat alex_room.txt)
ENC=$(printf '%s' "$ROOM_ID" | sed 's/!/%21/g; s/:/%3A/g')
echo "$TOM_USER" > tom_member.txt
curl -s -X POST --max-time 20 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ALEX_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "{\"user_id\":\"$TOM_USER\",\"room_id\":\"$ROOM_ID\"}" \
  "http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/rooms/$ENC/invite" -w "\n[invite http: %{http_code}]\n"
